overview: The Construction & Demolition Waste Processing Scheme is a government initiative under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC) aimed at managing and processing construction and demolition waste to promote sustainable waste management practices. The scheme supports the establishment of waste processing facilities to reduce environmental pollution and promote recycling of construction debris. It aligns with national goals for cleaner cities and sustainable urban development under waste management policies.
objectives: Promote scientific processing and recycling of construction and demolition waste
Reduce environmental pollution caused by unmanaged construction debris
Encourage private sector participation in waste management infrastructure
Support sustainable urban development through waste-to-resource conversion
Ensure compliance with environmental norms for waste disposal and processing
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include MSMEs, startups, and entrepreneurs engaged in waste management or recycling activities, particularly those involved in setting up construction and demolition waste processing units. Applicants must comply with environmental regulations and possess necessary clearances from pollution control boards and local authorities.
benefits: Financial assistance in the form of subsidies or grants for setting up waste processing facilities, technical support from MoEF&CC, facilitation of statutory clearances, promotion of recycled construction materials, and contribution to circular economy and Swachh Bharat Mission objectives.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial support through capital subsidies or grants for establishing construction and demolition waste processing plants. The exact quantum and mechanism are defined in scheme guidelines, with support aimed at reducing the financial burden on entrepreneurs and MSMEs entering the waste recycling sector.
application_process: 1. Identify eligibility under the scheme guidelines for construction and demolition waste processing. 2. Prepare project proposal including technical details, site plan, and environmental impact assessment. 3. Obtain necessary clearances from State Pollution Control Board and local authorities. 4. Submit application through the designated portal or nodal agency of MoEF&CC. 5. Application is reviewed by technical and financial appraisal committee. 6. Upon approval, financial sanction is released in installments based on project milestones. 7. Implement the project as per approved plan and submit utilization certificates.
required_documents: Project report detailing waste processing technology and capacity
Site plan and land ownership/lease documents
Environmental clearance from State Pollution Control Board
Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate under Air and Water Acts
GST registration and PAN of the applicant entity
Financial statements and bank solvency certificate
Details of machinery and equipment to be installed
Undertaking on compliance with environmental norms
implementing_agency: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC)
caveats: Subsidy is subject to availability of funds and approval by the competent authority
Beneficiaries must comply with all environmental and safety regulations
Funds are released in installments based on verification of progress
Misutilization of funds may lead to recovery and blacklisting
